protocol.prefill_batch: 64 maximum; MLX pre-fills all but last, then evaluates last token
protocol.max_context: nibblemac/llama 2048; MLX dynamic cache, same actual prompt/decode positions
protocol.first_token: logits included in prefill; nibblemac charges first argmax to decode, public adapters to prefill; rate = (generated_ids-1)/decode_seconds
protocol.warmup: same prompt + 4 decode steps; reset cache before timing

cache.mlx: bfloat16 K/V and conv state, fp32 recurrent matrices

protocol.mlx_adapter: direct synchronized model calls; no generate_step look-ahead or log-softmax
protocol.quality: reset each 512-token chunk; score positions 256..510 predicting 257..511
limitations: Different quantizers and weight provenance; not a pure backend comparison.
Cross-runtime output equality is not required; within-runtime repeatability is checked.
RSS is process high-water RSS including loading/warmup, not total unified GPU memory.
Sequential runs under advisory lock, working Mac, no thermal isolation.
